question: Among our top 10 paying customers, can you identify the largest change in payment amounts from one month to the immediately following month? Specifically, please determine for which customer and during which month this maximum month-over-month difference occurred, and provide the difference rounded to two decimal places.
sql:
WITH top10_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) as total_amount
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
    ORDER BY total_amount DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
monthly_payments AS (
    SELECT 
        p.customer_id,
        strftime('%Y-%m', p.payment_date) as payment_month,
        CAST(SUM(p.amount) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) as monthly_total
    FROM payment p
    WHERE p.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM top10_customers)
    GROUP BY p.customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', p.payment_date)
),
monthly_with_row_num AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        payment_month,
        monthly_total,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_month) as rn
    FROM monthly_payments
),
month_over_month AS (
    SELECT 
        m1.customer_id,
        m1.payment_month as current_month,
        m1.monthly_total as current_month_total,
        m2.payment_month as previous_month,
        m2.monthly_total as previous_month_total,
        ROUND(m1.monthly_total - m2.monthly_total, 2) as diff
    FROM monthly_with_row_num m1
    JOIN monthly_with_row_num m2 
        ON m1.customer_id = m2.customer_id 
        AND m1.rn = m2.rn + 1
)
SELECT 
    customer_id,
    current_month,
    diff,
    (SELECT first_name FROM customer WHERE customer_id = m1.customer_id) as customer_first_name,
    (SELECT last_name FROM customer WHERE customer_id = m1.customer_id) as customer_last_name
FROM month_over_month m1
ORDER BY diff DESC
LIMIT 5
